.d -- Decimal (ℝeal) or ⅅate Function (monadic) Reals Menu [CLK.1] f F5
(Also) reached from MENU (item) ⅅℸSET
Convert to decimal (ℝeal) or date value ; untag (ADM) angle ; clear Fractions Mode, #BASE Mode ; 
convert angles / ℸimes / ⅅates to ℝeal ; convert NIM input to ⅅate (according to CLK date format 
settings and implied conversion set by YY ; convert ℂomplex number with zero imaginary part to ℝeal 
; when editing angles using EDIT, key .d removes the angle tag (Normal Mode and PEM) ; when editing 
short integers, key .d removes the base (Normal Mode and PEM) ; in PEM, .d registers as →REAL (TI : 
decimal h: or yyyy.mmdd: ; Ref : https://47calc.com/doc/C47/Reference/C47_Date_formats.pdf)
Ref : https://47calc.com/doc/C47/Menus/C47_Menu_CLK_page_1.pdf

FACTORS FACTORS Prime factors Function (monadic) Integers Menu [X.FN.1] F3
Prime factors of the integer input in X ; factors are calculated in Long integer, stored as ℝeal 
number (34 digits) and returned as a 2 row matrix (row 1 contains the primes, row 2 contains the 
powers) ; shows status, number being tested and last factor found ; interrupt by [EXIT] ; registers 
G, H, K are used to store the last three factors, in Long integer (register K stores the remaining 
number to be factorised after interrupt) -- see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pollard's_rho_algorithm 
; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanks%27s_square_forms_factorization (Info : Pollard's rho algorithm 
and Shanks's square forms factorization are used ; prime factors will be accurate up to 3 317 044 
064 679 887 385 961 980 ; for input values > 34 digits, the long integer factors are saved in 
DATA/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS00>.REGS.TSV ; during execution, status info may be shown: Factors: Small 
prime trial: p = Factors: Perfect Sq trial: p = Factors: Shanks/Pollard↑: n = Factors: 
Shanks/Pollard↓: n =) [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pollard's_rho_algorithm ; 
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanks%27s_square_forms_factorization]
